form.createDescription: Give your project a name and choose its type.

description.label: Description (optional)
description.placeholder: A short summary of your project

export.failed: The project could not be exported.
export.notEncrypted: The .ganix file is not encrypted: it opens in any GANIS, from any account. Keep it somewhere safe.

warning.title: Export a private project?
warning.description:
The .ganix file of "{{name}}" will not be encrypted: anyone who gets it can read the project in GANIS, without your password.

Keep it somewhere safe (USB stick, personal folder) and only send it to people you trust.

import.failed: The project could not be imported.
import.title: Import this project?
import.description: The file has been checked. Nothing is added to your account until you confirm.
import.conflictDescription: A project in your account comes from this file. What would you like to do?

copy.label: Import as a copy
copy.description: Adds a new project named “{{name}} (importé)”. Your current project is unchanged.

replace.label: Replace my project
replace.description: Your project's content is replaced by the file's. An encrypted copy of the current version is first placed in the project trash (restorable for 30 days).

import.replaceConfirm: I confirm replacing my current project.
import.encryptionNote: The project will be encrypted with a new key as soon as it is added to your account.
import.replaced: Project “{{name}}” replaced. The previous version is in the project trash as “{{backup}}”: restorable for 30 days.
import.encryptionNoteReplace: The received data will be encrypted with your project's key.
